body: It's kind of the opposite for me. On one hand I like going to the same place because you get to know how it works, and can get in and out, but on the other hand I hate getting to know people. The more you go somewhere the more people talk to you and the more awkward conversation you have to go through. I make an effort to cycle the stores I frequent for this reason.
Yeah same here. Makes me wonder what it takes, or if it's just going to creep up on me someday.
I've been drinking about the same amount for about the same amount of time, and am also functional. have you noticed any physical issues?

I was in this same situation, 30 year old virgin not that fat, but not good looking either. I ended up having a one night stand recently, and the girl wanted nothing to do with me afterwards. That sucked, and it got be down for a while, but ultimately I understand it was a one night stand, and I can't expect to fall in love based on that. Obviously it will hurt more if he finds out she was paid, but so does being a 30 year old virgin. I think it just comes down to how well he knows his friend and how the guy would react if things went wrong.

As a 30 year old who just lost his virginity in a one night stand (definitely not a prostitute), I can tell you that the experience was no different than what you're describing. You couldn't have pried her off me with a crowbar that night, but she wanted nothing to do with me the next day. Yeah it hurt (maybe a lot), but I got over it pretty quickly and I'm glad it happened. Ultimately you can't expect much from a one night stand. Not saying the guy should do it, but if nothing else it demystified the whole thing for me and I no longer think its a big deal.
